acts.label: Prologue
acts.desc: Host Ira talks with comedian Gary Gulman about his transformation from high school nobody to football star.

acts.label: Act One
acts.desc: Gary puts on a tough guy costume, but will it turn him into a tough guy? Ira continues Gary Gulman’s story.

acts.label: Act Two
acts.desc: Eleanor Gordon-Smith tells the story of a woman who wants to know why she was taken away from her mom as a kid. A version of this story is in Eleanor’s book Stop Being Reasonable: How We Really Change Our Minds.
acts.title: Grownups Know Things
